name: Privy
tagline: Privy is an e-commerce marketing platform for Shopify and WooCommerce stores that combines pop-ups, email, and SMS marketing. Its AI helps create targeted campaigns based on cart abandonment, browsing behaviour, and purchase history, helping small e-commerce brands compete with enterprise marketing tools.
